text:
Ada: Quick follow-up from today — a few pricing/usage questions we promised to clarify after the all-hands. I'll list answers and a couple of open items we need input on.

Mike: Thanks! Can you confirm whether credits expire after 90 days or roll over?

Ada: Credits are going to expire after 180 days for promotional credits. Contracted prepaid credits for Dedicated customers roll per the contract (usually 12 months).

Sophia: Does that mean free trial credits (signup) also get 180d?

Ada: Yes — signup trial credits = 180d. We're changing from 90 to 180 to give teams more runway. :tada:

Jamal: What about rate limits vs quotas? I heard we have both now (rate limits per min + daily quotas). How do they interact for bursty workloads?

Ada: Good question. Short version: rate limits throttle request frequency (requests/min), quotas control consumption (units/day or credits). By default we allow a small burst window that temporarily exceeds per-minute SLO up to a burst cap, but quotas are still decremented. If quota exhausted, calls fail with 402 or 429 depending on config.

Robin: Can customers opt into soft vs hard quotas? Some teams want hard enforcement, others want a grace period with alerts.

Ada: Yes — console will expose two modes: "soft" (alerts + gradual throttling, honor grace bursts for N minutes) and "hard" (reject requests once quota depleted). Default is soft for self-serve. Enterprise contracts can require hard.

Mike: How are units defined now? Tokens, API calls, embeddings vectors?

Ada: We're moving to a unified "units" model for billing: generation tokens = 1 unit per 1k tokens, embedding vectors = 1 unit per 1k dims-per-1000-items (simplified), and reranking/other endpoints have a per-call multiplier. Billing docs will have a table.

Sophia: Is there a migration plan for customers on per-token billing?

Ada: Migration = automatic mapping for the first 6 months with a simulated bill in the console so customers can compare. We won't charge the new model until they opt in or after the migration window (we'll notify 30 days before).

Jamal: What about rate limit headers in responses — will we expose remaining quota and reset time?

Ada: Yes. We'll include headers: \n```\nX-RateLimit-Limit: 120\nX-RateLimit-Remaining: 47\nX-RateLimit-Reset: 1710000000  # epoch seconds\nX-Quota-Remaining-Units: 12345\n```\nThese are included for hosted API and Dedicated control plane. Private deployments will get the same semantics but the headers are configurable.

Robin: Can we get per-route quotas? For example, embeddings route separate from chat generation so product can allocate budgets.

Ada: Absolutely — console will let you create quotas scoped by route, tag, or API key. We'll also add a REST endpoint for programmatic quota assignment (useful for platform teams).

Mike: Are there guardrails for per-route quotas to prevent misconfiguration (e.g., setting a route to 0 accidentally)?

Ada: We'll show safety checks in the UI and a staged rollout if a change reduces quota by >50% for production API keys — requires confirmation. We'll also surface a deploy diff and an API preview.

Sophia: Any updates on free tier size and whether embeddings are counted differently?

Ada: Free tier remains — we increased the embeddings allotment to better support prototyping (now 50k vector-units per month). We want to avoid blocking dev UX.

Jamal: BillingBot: can you post the link to the new draft pricing doc?

BillingBot: Sure — https://redwood.example.com/pricing/draft-v2 (internal only).

Robin: One more: SLA impact? If a customer switches to hard quotas and hits them, does that count as an incident impacting SLA?

Ada: No — quota enforcement is expected behavior and doesn't count against platform uptime. SLA covers service availability and model-serving latency, not self-imposed limits. We'll clarify in the SLA doc.

Mike: Outstanding items we need from Eng/Product: (1) final units-to-tokens conversion table, (2) UI copy for soft/hard modes, (3) API spec for quota endpoints. Can we commit owners?

Sophia: I'll own (1) with Research — deliver by EOD Friday.

Robin: I'll own (2) — I'll draft UX copy and put a PR in the console repo by Monday.

Jamal: I'll take (3) — will post a swagger snippet in #eng-platform by Thursday.

Ada: Great — thanks all. If anything else comes up from the all-hands Qs, reply in this thread. :sparkles:
